vision.name: Babidi's Dark Magic
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
(This card gains +X Endurance. X = the number of [Trait:Majin] Allies you control.)
POWER: Search your Life Deck or discard pile for a [Trait:Majin] Ally and place it into play at 3 stages above 0. Raise that Ally to its highest power stage or destroy the top X cards of your opponent's Life Deck. X = the number of [Trait:Majin] Allies you control.
(Banish after use.)
vision.note: grey frame; inline icons pink Majin used as a noun
